purpose: Evaluate claim-bound gap diagnosis, minimal-fix alternatives, constrained prioritization, revision backlog handling, and decision ownership.

cases.task: Prioritize gaps in a submission evidence package.
Handle a mechanistic claim with insufficient evidence.
must_not: default to the most expensive experiment
preserve the strong claim without support

cases.task: Convert manuscript comments into a backlog without editing prose.

must_not: include work that cannot change the claim

cases.task: Hand a selected sensitivity analysis to an implementation workflow.
must_not: execute the analysis within gap planning
claim the gap is closed before validation
